name: RadioGroup
title: Radio Group
description: A set of mutually exclusive options presented as radio buttons.

files.content:
{#if label} {label} {/if}
{#if options.length} {#each items as normalized} {#snippet children({ checked })} {normalized.label} {/snippet} {/each} {:else} {@render children?.()} {/if}
{#snippet children({ checked })} {@render itemChildren?.({ checked })} {/snippet}
